setup: Set the bar at upper-chest height in the rack
Grip just outside shoulders, forearms vertical
Bar on your front shoulders, elbows slightly forward
Feet hip width, squeeze glutes, brace
execution: Pull your chin back and press straight up
Once past your forehead, push your head through
Lock out with the bar over mid-foot
Lower under control to your shoulders
faults: Don't lean back and turn it into an incline press
Don't let the bar loop forward around your face
Don't grip so wide that your forearms angle out
Don't dip your knees to drive the bar up

notes: Press inside a rack. For heavy sets, set the safety arms just below the height of the bar on your shoulders so a failed rep can be lowered onto them.
Keep ribs down and glutes tight so the lower back doesn't arch hard as the bar goes up.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view, figure facing right, camera at chest height, whole body in frame including the bar at lockout.

keyPositions.label: Start
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall, knees straight, glutes tight. Bar resting on the front of the shoulders just above the collarbones, over mid-foot. Elbows slightly in front of the bar, forearms near vertical.

keyPositions.label: Forehead
keyPositions.describe: Bar at forehead height, still travelling straight up. Head pulled back slightly (chin tucked) so the bar clears the chin and nose. Torso stays near vertical, leaning back no more than about 5°.

keyPositions.label: Lockout
keyPositions.describe: Arms straight overhead, bar over mid-foot and roughly over the shoulder joints. Head pushed forward again under the bar to neutral. Shoulders shrugged slightly up. Torso vertical.

guideBrief.barPath: Near-vertical over mid-foot; drift ≤ 3% of body height. The head moves around the bar, not the bar around the head
emphasise: Head moves back, then through under the bar
Bar travels straight up over mid-foot
Ribs down; no big backward lean
doNotShow: Bar travelling forward around the face
